risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 192 crisis regime, negative macro score -7) creates severe headwinds; earnings in 48 days adds moderate event risk but does not mitigate current systemic risk environment.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, high credit spreads), zero fundamental support, RSI exhaustion at 84.6, below-average volume, and price below VWAP create a hostile environment that overwhelms technical strength.

decision.primary_risk: Macro environment (VIX 192, inverted yield curve, high credit spreads) combined with RSI exhaustion at 84.6 and below-average volume create high probability of mean reversion into earnings in 48 days.
